capabilities: Organize scenes into an ordered, nestable project list from a dedicated sidebar
Track scene, draft, and project word counts and daily writing session goals
Create and manage multiple drafts of the same project
Compile projects into a manuscript through customizable step workflows
Style project panes via an auto-attached CSS class for writing-only themes
extras: Detailed setup guide is in the README but full documentation lives elsewhere; a community collection of compile steps exists. README warns that projects rely on longform frontmatter and that malformed frontmatter can cause desync, which a restart fixes.
problem: Obsidian treats notes as standalone files, so writers of novels or screenplays lack a way to order scenes into a project, track drafts, and compile a manuscript.
summary: Long-form writing toolkit that organizes scenes into ordered, nestable manuscripts with word counts, drafts, writing goals, and compilation workflows.
